rules.very_close: at or above the median similarity between a word and its single nearest neighbour
rules.related: at or above the 99th percentile of all word pairs
rules.loosely_related: at or above the 90th percentile of all word pairs
rules.unrelated: below the 90th percentile of all word pairs
